description: Defines classes and interfaces for MIDI management, including MidiManager and MidiManagerClient, with methods for session control, port management, and MIDI data handling in a Chromium-based project.

classes.name: MidiManagerClient
classes.description: Interface for clients to receive MIDI data and port status updates, and to control port states.

classes.name: MidiManager
classes.description: Manages access to MIDI hardware, sessions, and data transmission, supporting multiple clients and platform-specific initialization.

methods.name: StartSession
methods.description: Begins a MIDI session for a client, initializing MIDI system if needed.

methods.name: EndSession
methods.description: Ends a MIDI session for a client.

methods.name: DispatchSendMidiData
methods.description: Sends MIDI data to the hardware asynchronously.
